paintings.title: Queen K, first light
paintings.text: Oil study of the highway at dawn: the lava is still black, the sky has already turned. One rider, very small, already in the tuck.

provenance.prompt: Original museum-quality oil painting on canvas: an empty two-lane highway crossing black lava fields on the Big Island of Hawaii at dawn, a single time-trial cyclist far away as a small dark silhouette in an aero tuck, heat shimmer, pink and gold sky over a volcano, thick impasto brushwork. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.

paintings.title: Crosswind
paintings.text: The wind decides the line here. Grass flattened one way, the rider leaning the other.

provenance.prompt: Original expressive oil painting: fierce crosswinds on a coastal lava highway, dry golden fountain grass bent flat, a blurred abstract cyclist leaning into the wind, turquoise ocean on the horizon, energetic diagonal brushstrokes. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.

paintings.title: Kohala, the turn
paintings.text: Green hills and the road folding back on itself: halfway, and the wind is about to change sides.

provenance.prompt: Original gouache painting: green rolling hills of North Kohala, Hawaii, under drifting trade-wind clouds, a winding road turning back on itself, flat graphic shapes, soft pastel palette, mid-century travel-poster feeling but painterly. No text, no letters, no logos.

paintings.title: Race morning, the bay
paintings.text: From above, a start line is just colour on water: thousands of caps, one pier.

provenance.prompt: Original painting of a mass open-water swim start in a tropical bay at sunrise seen from above, thousands of tiny swim caps rendered as dots of bright colour on deep blue water, white splashes, a pier on one side, dotted pointillist technique, luminous. No text, no letters, no logos, no identifiable people.

paintings.title: Streamlines
paintings.text: Smoke in a wind tunnel does not argue. It shows you where the air wants to go.

provenance.prompt: Original minimalist ink painting on warm paper: white smoke streamlines flowing smoothly around an abstract teardrop airfoil shape in a wind tunnel, black sumi ink, lots of empty space, calm and precise. No text, no letters, no logos, no signature.

paintings.title: Silhouette in moving air
paintings.text: A time-trial bike in a few strokes, and the air it pushes aside in a few more.

provenance.prompt: Original Japanese-inspired brush painting: the side silhouette of a generic time-trial bicycle with disc wheels drawn in a few confident black brushstrokes, surrounded by flowing air currents in pale indigo washes, on textured rice paper. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no seal stamps.

paintings.title: Night boards
paintings.text: An empty velodrome after hours: the banking holds the light, one rider holds the line.

provenance.prompt: Original oil painting: an empty indoor wooden velodrome at night, steep banked boards glowing under a few lamps, a single track cyclist as a motion blur on the banking, deep shadows, cinematic warm and cool light. No text, no letters, no logos, no advertising boards.

paintings.title: Midnight on the seawall
paintings.text: The finish at midnight: lanterns, wet asphalt, and a crowd that stayed.

provenance.prompt: Original impressionist oil painting: a seaside town street at midnight during a long-distance race, a lit finish arch glowing warm, paper lanterns, palm trees, a crowd rendered as loose blurred strokes, reflections on wet asphalt. No text, no letters, no logos, no readable signs.

paintings.title: Where the lava meets the sea
paintings.text: Two elements, no border: orange, black and the steam between them.

provenance.prompt: Original abstract expressionist colour-field painting: molten orange lava meeting black ocean water, rising white steam, large bold fields of colour, thick scraped paint, dramatic contrast. No text, no letters, no logos, no signature.

paintings.title: Mirage
paintings.text: Heat off the lava until the road stops being a road. A runner keeps going anyway.

provenance.prompt: Original surreal oil painting: a desert road through black lava dissolving into a white-hot heat mirage, the horizon melting into light, a lone runner as a tiny figure, bleached palette with a single cobalt sky band. No text, no letters, no logos.

paintings.title: The builder's bench
paintings.text: Tubes, lugs, a torch and files: every bike in the museum started on a bench like this.

provenance.prompt: Original chiaroscuro still-life oil painting: a frame builder's workbench with steel bicycle tubes, brass lugs, a brazing torch and hand files, lit by one window, deep Dutch-master shadows. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.

paintings.title: Twill
paintings.text: Carbon weave as ornament: black and gold, over and under, bent into a wave.

provenance.prompt: Original geometric abstract painting inspired by woven carbon fibre: interlaced black and gold bands forming a shimmering twill pattern that bends like a wave, gold leaf accents, precise hard-edge style. No text, no letters, no logos.
